subject.title: feat: add codexbar cookie refresh CLI command

question: Should cookie recovery extend `cache clear --cookies --provider`, or remain a separate `cookie refresh` command?
rationale: The existing command already performs the reliable cross-provider action, while entitlement limits prevent the new command from consistently delivering its distinct immediate-refresh promise.

options.title: Extend cache clear
options.body: Add an explicit re-import or deferred-refresh mode to the existing cache command and retain one provider-driven recovery surface.

options.title: Keep cookie refresh
options.body: Retain the new command only if it delegates to the shared provider import pipeline and clearly distinguishes immediate from deferred refresh.

recommendation.title: Extend cache clear
recommendation.body: Add an explicit re-import or deferred-refresh mode to the existing cache command and retain one provider-driven recovery surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership and recent integration work across the CLI and provider boundary make steipete the best available decision owner.
